data.name: Pulse-tube helium flex lines
data.function: Stainless flexible lines carrying high- and low-pressure helium between the remote compressor and the pulse-tube head. Their length and routing are chosen to decouple compressor vibration; the pressures they carry are monitored because a loss of pressure difference is the first sign of compressor failure and leads to a warm-up of the 4 K stage within hours.

physics.summary: Helium supply to the pulse tube; no thermal role in the insert.

data.tooltip: Helium lines from the compressor to the pulse-tube head.
